events.verdict: Oubre Jr. (PHI) slightly drifts forward as he contests Shamet's (NYK) jump shot attempt and marginal body occurs after Shamet returns to the floor.
Embiid (PHI) briefly clasps and releases Anunoby's (NYK) arm as they engage and separate in the post off-ball,
Anunoby (NYK) and Embiid (PHI) come together at the same spot in the post, and the body-to-body contact that occurs is marginal.
Embiid (PHI) brings his arms forward and marginal contact occurs with Anunoby (NYK) off-ball as Embiid releases away to retrieve the pass.
Anunoby (NYK) retreats and turns away in Embiid's (PHI) path when marginal off-arm contact occurs during Embiid's shot attempt in the post.
Edgecombe (PHI) reaches for the ball when marginal contact occurs with Brunson (NYK) in the backcourt.
Brunson (NYK) slides his off-arm off Edgecombe's (PHI) side as he dribbles around Edgecombe on the perimeter.
Edgecombe (PHI) grazes Brunson (NYK) as George (PHI) gets his hand directly on the ball to tie it up. The jump ball is correctly assessed prior to NYK attempting to signal for a timeout.
Brunson (NYK) grabs and holds Edgecombe's (PHI) arm, which affects his ability to pursue the jump ball.

Replay review of the foul called on Brunson (NYK) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Edgecombe (PHI) extends his arms outward and initiates illegal contact with Brunson (NYK) off-ball, which affects his FOM. The contact from Edgecombe to Brunson occurs first and prior to any from Brunson.
Anunoby (NYK) establishes a screening position outside of Edgecombe's (PHI) field of view and gives him a step to avoid the contact.
Bona (PHI) commits a take foul on Anunoby (NYK).
Maxey (PHI) makes contact with the ball simultaneously as incidental contact occurs with McBride (NYK) at the start of his dribble in the backcourt.
Embiid (PHI) did not initiate contact with Shamet (NYK) that is more than marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on George (PHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. George (PHI) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Anunoby's (NYK) layup attempt.
Shamet (NYK) extends his arms forward and initiates illegal contact with Maxey's (PHI) body in attempt to commit a take foul.
Maxey (PHI) drifts forward after the release of his jump shot attempt as Anunoby (NYK) jumps vertically to legally contest the shot. Incidental contact occurs as Maxey lands.
George (PHI) and Hart (NYK) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Edgecombe (PHI) commits a take foul on Brunson (NYK).
There is no clear and conclusive angle that confirms Brunson's (NYK) contact is to Embiid's (PHI) wrist/arm and not to the ball or the part of Embiid's hand that is in contact with the ball.
